#Load packages
```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
```

#Load the original ESV tables in
```{r}
BR5_ESVs <- read.csv("data/rawData/esv_tables/0_BR5_StreamCLIMES_eDNA_sequence_read_table_part_0.csv")

COIF230_ESVs <- read.csv("data/rawData/esv_tables/0_COIF230_StreamCLIMES_eDNA_sequence_read_table_part_0.csv")
  
UNICOI_ESVs <- read.csv("data/rawData/esv_tables/0_UNICOI_StreamCLIMES_eDNA_sequence_read_table_part_0.csv")

```

#What/how many ESVs are present in multiple primers?

```{r}
br5_coif230_overlap <- intersect(BR5_ESVs$sequence, COIF230_ESVs$sequence)
length(br5_coif230_overlap)
br5_unicoi_overlap <- intersect(BR5_ESVs$sequence, UNICOI_ESVs$sequence)
length(br5_unicoi_overlap)
coif230_unicoi_overlap <- intersect(COIF230_ESVs$sequence, UNICOI_ESVs$sequence)
length(coif230_unicoi_overlap)

#there are no ESVs that overlap between the 3 primers
```

#since there are no ESVs that overlap as long as the esvs get a column with primer name for any downstream analysis/issues, the header on the pools can be removed and the ESVs can be merged into one large table

```{r}
#add column with what primer generated ESV
BR5_ESVs <- BR5_ESVs %>% mutate(primer = "BR5")
COIF230_ESVs <- COIF230_ESVs %>% mutate(primer = "COIF230")
UNICOI_ESVs <- UNICOI_ESVs %>% mutate(primer = "UNICOI")

#remove the prefix in columns 3-67 that keep the columns in each dataframe from lining up
names(BR5_ESVs)[3:67] <- sub("^BR5_", "", names(BR5_ESVs)[3:67])
names(COIF230_ESVs)[3:67] <- sub("^COIF230_", "", names(COIF230_ESVs)[3:67])
names(COIF230_ESVs)[3:67] <- sub("_PE$", "", names(COIF230_ESVs)[3:67])
names(UNICOI_ESVs)[3:67] <- sub("^UniCOI_", "", names(UNICOI_ESVs)[3:67])


#add column with what primer generated ESV
BR5_ESVs <- BR5_ESVs %>% mutate(primer = "BR5")
COIF230_ESVs <- COIF230_ESVs %>% mutate(primer = "COIF230")
UNICOI_ESVs <- UNICOI_ESVs %>% mutate(primer = "UNICOI")


all_ESVs <- rbind(BR5_ESVs, COIF230_ESVs, UNICOI_ESVs)
```

#read in metadata to convert pool ID to site names (Convert to csv)
```{r}
pools_to_sites <- read_xlsx("sampleID_sitenames_metadata.xlsx")
```

##assign site names instead of the pooled ID
```{r}
all_ESVs_withsite <- all_ESVs %>%
  rename_with(~ pools_to_sites$Site[match(., pools_to_sites$SampleID)],
              .cols = pools_to_sites$SampleID)

colnames(all_ESVs_withsite)
```
